ValidationRule.description: Prevents the agent from saving the Scam record if all the mandatory fields are not populated.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, RecordType.DeveloperName = "Scam", NOT( ISPICKVAL(Type, "")), NOT( ISPICKVAL(Type, "Not a Scam") ), OR( ISBLANK(Fraud_Detection_Case_Reference__c), ISPICKVAL(Fraud_Loss_Reason_Code__c, ""), ISPICKVAL(Fraud_Recipient_Remitter__c, ""), ISBLANK(Fraud_Total_Scam_Value__c), Fraud_Total_Scam_Value__c < 0, ISBLANK(Fraud_Total_Falcon_Recalled__c) , Fraud_Total_Falcon_Recalled__c < 0, ISBLANK(Fraud_Total_Customer_Exposure__c), Fraud_Total_Customer_Exposure__c < 0 ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: These fields are required: Detection Case Reference, Loss Reason Code, Payment to Remitter/Exchange, Total Scam Value, Total Falcon Recalled, Total Customer Exposure
